name: text-underline-draw
title: Underline Draw
description: Một nét gạch chân mọc từ trái sang dưới chữ trong 0.4 giây, khi rút thì thu về phía bên phải.

moworks.author: moworks

options.exitAt: s after the start: it shrinks toward its right end in 0.35 s (null: stay)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Line under the text: 0.08 em thick (min 2 px), 0.16 em below the baseline (CSS bottom −0.12 em), round ends, accent; one line per text line. Draw: scaleX 0 → 1 from the left, 0.4 s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) (demo 0.5–0.9 s). Exit: origin flips to the right and the line shrinks toward its right end, 0.35 s same ease (demo 2.1–2.45 s). Loop 2.8 s. Params: duration (0.4 s) · thickness (0.08 em) · offset: cách chân chữ (0.16 em) · ease (cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)).
moworks.titleVi: Gạch chân mọc ra rồi rút về phải
